name: STORM-0817
brief: OpenAI disrupted Storm-0817, an Iran-based actor using ChatGPT to debug rudimentary Android surveillanceware (two APKs — `com.example.myttt` and `com.mihanwebmaster.ashpazi` — capable of exfiltrating contacts, call logs, screenshots, IMEI, and geolocation, plus WhatsApp/IMO files), build C2 server code (a WAMP-stack server at `stickhero[.]pro`), debug an Instagram-scraping tool tested against an Iranian journalist critical of the government, and translate LinkedIn profiles of Pakistani cybersecurity/military-affiliated academics into Persian. OpenAI: "we believe our models only offered limited, incremental capabilities for malicious cybersecurity tasks beyond what is already achievable with publicly available, non-AI powered tools." *Backfill note: see CyberAv3ngers row above — same October 2024 report.* OpenAI
